```python
def format_pence(pence):
    """Pence as pounds for display: 1234 -> '£12.34', -300 -> '-£3.00'."""
    sign = "-" if pence < 0 else ""
    pounds, p = divmod(abs(pence), 100)
    return f"{sign}£{pounds}.{p:02d}"
```
